title: Cross-browser & responsive QA sweep for UI Kit tokens, buttons, tables, charts — triage and fixes
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
We ran a focused cross-browser and responsive QA sweep across the UI Kit surface (tokens, buttons, table components, chart containers) to validate visual parity and interaction reliability in Safari, Firefox, desktop Chrome, iOS Safari, and Android Chrome. This ticket triages the findings, assigns remediation owners, and defines acceptance criteria for the March DS release.

Scope & Goals:
- Verify token usage (colors, spacing, type sizes) doesn’t produce visual regressions across browsers or when reduced-motion / high-contrast OS settings are enabled.
- Ensure primary/ghost/inline button variants have consistent focus/active states, hit areas, and tap feedback on mobile.
- Confirm responsive behavior for tables (collapse/wrapping/truncation) and chart containers (resize, canvas SVG pixel alignment) at common breakpoints: 320px, 375px, 412px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px.
- Surface cross-browser bugs with reproduction steps, severity, suggested fix, and owner.

Test Matrix (initial run):
- Desktop Chrome (latest), Firefox (latest), Safari (macOS latest)
- iOS Safari (13-17), Android (Chrome latest on Pixel 6/7 emulation)
- Accessibility checks: keyboard focus on desktop, VoiceOver basic smoke on iOS, color contrast for token pairs failing WCAG AA.

Key Findings (triaged):
1) Token — neutral-300 / neutral-400 contrast shift in Safari when using system font-smoothing (macOS) (Bug ID: DSX-174)
   - Repro: Open Colors page, toggle system font smoothing, compare neutral-300 swatch relative contrast.
   - Severity: P2 (visual, low functional impact but customer-visible).
   - Suggestion: Force background-blend-mode fallback or adjust exported token values for Safari. Owner: Marco Ruiz / ENG-4213.

2) Button — primary button focus ring disappears on Firefox when using compact density (Bug ID: DSX-175)
   - Repro: Set density=compact on Buttons page, Tab to primary button in Firefox.
   - Severity: P1 (a11y, keyboard users blocked from clear focus).
   - Suggestion: Use outline-offset and fallback outline styles, avoid relying on -webkit-focus-ring-color. Owner: Design + ENG. Blocker for release.

3) Button — iOS Safari tap highlight (blue flash) shows on ghost buttons with transparent background (Bug ID: DSX-176)
   - Repro: Tap ghost button in iOS Safari; fast double-tap reproduces.
   - Severity: P2 (annoying tap feedback that contrasts with brand).
   - Suggestion: apply -webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(...) and set touch-action where appropriate. Owner: Marco.

4) Tables — row height collapse on Firefox when using vertical-align: middle with icons (Bug ID: DSX-177)
   - Repro: Table > row with icon + multi-line cell in Firefox; CSS flex fallback case triggers.
   - Severity: P1 (layout regression causing misaligned rows).
   - Suggestion: enforce min-height and use align-items: center on flex container instead of vertical-align. Owner: ENG-4213.

5) Charts — pixel blurriness on high-DPI Safari when canvas is resized dynamically (Bug ID: DSX-178)
   - Repro: Resize chart container on Safari on macOS with Retina display; observe blurry axis labels.
   - Severity: P2.
   - Suggestion: Ensure devicePixelRatio-aware canvas scaling and redraw hooks; add test in chart wrapper. Owner: Frontend Charts team (ENG-4302).

Acceptance Criteria:
- All P1 items fixed with PRs merged or tracked ENG issues with clear timelines prior to release cut-off.
- P2 items either fixed or have documented mitigations and a follow-up engineering ticket.
- QA checklist updated in Confluence (link in comments) and visual diffs captured for each browser.

Notes / Trade-offs:
- Some Safari-only token adjustments may slightly shift perceived color on other platforms; prefer targeted CSS workarounds over global token changes to preserve API stability.
- Where fixes require significant layout refactors (tables), prefer scoped patches and add regression tests rather than wholesale redesign.

Next Steps:
- ENG to pick up ENG-4213 (tables + focus ring) and ENG-4302 (charts) this sprint.
- Design to produce updated token guidance for Safari edge-cases and provide CSS snippet PR for tap-highlight.
- QA will perform a validation pass after PRs land and update this ticket with pass/fail screenshots.

Relevant artifacts:
- Design notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Cross-browser+QA+2026-02
- Test plan: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-ui-kit-cross-browser
- Visual diffs (Dropbox): https://redwood.screenshots/dropbox/ui-kit-0226
